rationale: The assistant reached a reasonable escalation to an engineer, correctly pointing to the heater or safety cut-out. However, it kept pushing the non-existent condenser panel/flap after the customer said there wasn't one. It also never named the interrupted-cycle thermal cut-out explicitly as a likely one-shot cause, never offered a continuity test or looked at the heater housing, and wrongly said the part is not user-replaceable without professional tools. It also never asked for the full model number to support any part identification, and the suggestion to run another cycle was only marginally useful.
